title: Story premise EDU082: The Chart Cannot Spend Color Twice
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (accessibility/inclusion). Hook: If these colors look the same, what else tells them apart? Takeaway/theme: Do not make color the sole carrier of essential information.
description: A reader wants to identify the two lines in a chart, but color is the only distinction. Adding direct labels and different stroke patterns makes the intended comparison available through more than one visual cue.
